extracted.name: Espresso Martini
extracted.description: Recipe video above. This will wake you up - AND get you partying! I love having espresso martinis when I need a pick me up at the start of an evening, and for after dinner drinks. USE SCALER to make multiple drinks or for a larger glass.
instruction_lines: Place the vodka, kahlua and espresso in a cocktail shaker with ice.
Shake vigorously 10 times, then pour briskly into a cocktail glass. (Scrape out foam inside if necessary)
Garnish wtih 3 coffee beans and serve immediately.
